name: Physical Oceanography
summary: The physics of ocean circulation, water masses, waves and mixing, from the surface layer to the abyss.

topics.name: Temperature, salinity, density and the equation of state of seawater
Heat and freshwater budgets of the ocean
Equations of motion on a rotating Earth
Geostrophic currents and the thermal wind
Wind-driven circulation: Sverdrup balance and western boundary currents
Ocean waves: surface gravity waves, internal waves, Kelvin and Rossby waves
Ocean observing: CTDs, floats (Argo), moorings and satellites
